caption_L2L3: The data show an increase in the sales value of beer from 2008/2009 to 2015/2016 from between 800 and 1000 million Canadian dollars to between 1000 and 1200 million Canadian dollars. There is a brief dip in sales that does not follow the trend in 2010/2011 but otherwise there is an increase to 2015/2016. After this year there is a slight decline down to near 1000 million Canadian dollars in 2019.
